entities.label: Person
entities.summary:
Manuel Pessanha was a 14th century Genoese merchant sailor who served as the first admiral of Portugal at the time of King Denis of Portugal.


He played a pivotal role in establishing Portugal's maritime dominance in the Mediterranean during the early years of the Portuguese Empire, expanding trade and exploration to North Africa, the Middle East, and India.


This achievement not only marked a significant turning point in Portugal's rise to global prominence but also set the stage for the country's future exploration and colonization of the Atlantic and Pacific Oceans.


Despite his enduring legacy, Manuel Pessanha remains a relatively lesser-known figure in historical records, overshadowed by more prominent figures of the time.
